title: Constrained Projective Dynamics: Real-Time Simulation of Deformable Objects with Energy-Momentum Conservation
excerpt: A novel energy-momentum conserving integration method that extends Projective Dynamics with position-based energy-momentum constraints, eliminating unwanted dissipation without compromising real-time performance.
citation: Min Hyung Kee, Kiwon Um, WooSeok Jeong, and JungHyun Han. (2021). "Constrained Projective Dynamics: Real-Time Simulation of Deformable Objects with Energy-Momentum Conservation." ACM Transactions on Graphics (SIGGRAPH 2021). 40(4), Article 160. https://doi.org/10.1145/3450626.3459878

title: An Optimization-based SPH Solver for Simulation of Hyperelastic Solids
excerpt: A novel method for simulating hyperelastic solids with SPH, reformulating implicit integration as an optimization problem solved with L-BFGS, covering Neo-Hookean and St. Venant-Kirchhoff materials in a unified solid-fluid framework.
citation: Min Hyung Kee, Kiwon Um, HyunMo Kang, and JungHyun Han. (2023). "An Optimization-based SPH Solver for Simulation of Hyperelastic Solids." Computer Graphics Forum (EUROGRAPHICS 2023). 42(2), 225-233. https://doi.org/10.1111/cgf.14756

title: Inversion alleviation for stable elastic body simulation
excerpt: A simple yet highly effective method for alleviating element inversion problems when simulating elastic bodies undergoing large deformations.
citation: JaeHyun Lee, Seung-wook Kim, Min Hyung Kee, Kiwon Um, and JungHyun Han. (2023). "Inversion alleviation for stable elastic body simulation." Computer Animation & Virtual Worlds. 34, e2183. https://doi.org/10.1002/cav.2183

title: Momentum-preserving inversion alleviation for elastic material simulation
excerpt: A novel method enhancing the optimization-based elastic body solver to tackle the element inversion problem while preserving momentum.
citation: Heejo Jeong, Seung-wook Kim, JaeHyun Lee, Min Hyung Kee, Kiwon Um, and JungHyun Han. (2024). "Momentum-preserving inversion alleviation for elastic material simulation." Computer Animation & Virtual Worlds. 35, e2249. https://doi.org/10.1002/cav.2249
